dossier_meta.catalog_title: Maximum Independent Set complexity for H-free graphs when H contains P7, S1,1,3, or S1,2,2
dossier_meta.statement_text: Determine the computational complexity of the Maximum Independent Set problem for $H$-free graphs whenever $H$ is some $S_{i,j,k}$ that contains either $P_7$, $S_{1,1,3}$, or $S_{1,2,2}$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The problem is polynomial for $H \subseteq P_k$ with $k \leq 6$ and for $H \subseteq S_{i,j,k}$ with $(i,j,k) \leq (1,1,2)$, and is NP-hard when $H$ is not an induced subgraph of any $S_{i,j,k}$. The boundary region where $H$ contains $P_7$, $S_{1,1,3}$, or $S_{1,2,2}$ is listed as completely open.
